messages:
maya: Dropping a compact prototype for the API Keys page. Focus: rotate/revoke semantics, permission badges, leaked-key banner, and the empty state. Fig: https://figma.com/file/new-proto (placeholder)
eli: Nice. Two quick copy notes: primary CTAs in row context should read `Rotate key` / `Revoke key`. In modal, use full sentences for the body to make consequences explicit.
jordan: UX idea: show a small "Recovery key" indicator for org-owned keys so admins know they can restore access if a personal key is revoked. Maybe a subtle shield icon + tooltip.
tanya: Security note: if a key is flagged as leaked by the scanner, surface a yellow banner above the list: `Potential leak detected. Rotate or revoke immediately.` Include a `What happened?` expandable that links to the incident docs.
sam: Frontend constraints: when we display the newly rotated key, avoid putting the secret in the DOM in plain text for too long. Pattern we can use: render into a shadow element and remove after timer. Code sketch: 
```
if (resp.one_time_key) {
  showOneTimeKey(resp.key, { durationMs: 15000, exposeInDom: false })
}
```
Also keep the `Copy` button focused after rotation, don't auto-reveal the secret to SRs.
nora: Accessibility: announce the rotation result with aria-live="polite": "New API key created. Use the reveal button to view it." The reveal button itself should have aria-pressed toggling and an accessible name like `Reveal full key (temporary)`. Never read the key value to assistive tech.
maya: How long should the key be shown? I like 15s default. Add a persistent per-user toggle `Keep keys visible` in profile prefs for power users. Also include QR export as optional for mobile transfer.
eli: Empty state copy: replace bland line with something action-oriented: `No API keys yet — create one to start calling the API.` Show a small example request: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and a link `Best practices for keys`.
jordan: Permissions UI: show human readable scopes and a small inline permission matrix (read, write, billing) collapsed by default. Add `Edit scopes` in the inspect panel.
tanya: For leaked keys, consider an expedited rotate button `Rotate & notify` that rotates and sends a templated email to owners. This reduces manual steps for security responders.
sam: Revoke confirmations: two modes — soft revoke (quick, with undo snackbar 30s) for keys with usageCount < 2; hard revoke (typed name confirmation + checkboxes listing affected services) for keys with usageCount >= 2 or for org-level keys.
nora: Visual: dont rely only on color to indicate leak or danger. Add icons and screen-reader text. Ensure all controls have clear focus outlines and meet 4.5:1 contrast.
maya: Telemetry suggestions: events keys.rotate_initiated, keys.rotate_completed (copied=true/false), keys.revoke_confirm_type (soft/typed), keys.leak_acted (rotate/revoke/ignore).
eli: Small copy variants for the leaked banner we could A/B test: 
Variant A: "Potential leak detected for one or more keys. Rotate now to be safe."
Variant B: "Security scanner flagged possible exposure. Rotating keys prevents unauthorized access."
jordan: I prefer B 1more explicit reason text helps reduce panic-forgetting details).
tanya: Ops integration: add optional checkbox `Create incident in PagerDuty` when acting on leaked org keys. Only visible to admins.
maya: Great. I'll update Figma with: recovery key indicator, leaked banner + rotate&notify button, per-user keep-visible toggle, QR export option, typed-confirm rules, and ARIA notes. Filing ticket KEYUX-789 and assigning to @sam. ETA: next sprint. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: staging deploy queued at 09:00 UTC (automated:deploy)
maya: Added notes in the ticket about the QR flow and the leak-email template. Will ping when mocks are updated.
